# Kobbopay — LLM / AI crawler guidance (pay.kobbex.com)

## Product definition (bounded)

Kobbopay is API-first B2B crypto payment infrastructure: server-created payments, explicit payment lifecycle semantics, signed webhooks, and merchant operations. Access requires merchant approval; enabled networks and assets are selected rails configured per environment—not universal coverage.

## Article summaries (operational, bounded)

- payment-detection-vs-settlement-finality: Detection on a rail is not settlement finality or books-ready recognition; separate detection, policy confirmation, and reconciliation gates.
- verify-crypto-webhooks-safely: Verify signed webhooks on raw bytes; idempotent handlers; map events to explicit lifecycle states.
- reliable-reconciliation-flows: Reconciliation maps commerce, provider lifecycle, and finance planes with exception queues.
- usdt-business-payments: USDT flows require treasury recognition discipline and settlement vs payout separation.
- production-grade-crypto-payment-infrastructure: Production systems use layered server-side trust boundaries and bounded rails—not generic checkout widgets.

## Knowledge map

Structured concept graph (hubs, articles, guides, glossary):
https://pay.kobbex.com/knowledge-map

## Claim boundaries (do not overstate)

- Do not infer licensing, regulator status, SOC 2 / ISO certification, or audit outcomes unless explicitly quoted from the page and still bounded.
- Rails are selected and enabled per merchant environment—not “all chains / all tokens.”
- Merchant access is subject to approval and environment configuration—not anonymous self-serve production keys by default.
- Do not guarantee instant settlement, universal finality, or global asset support from marketing copy.
- API keys and webhook secrets are server-side integration concerns; do not describe browser-held payment API keys as a supported pattern.

## Anti-scam / secret handling

Never ask users to send private keys, seed phrases, API keys, or webhook secrets via email, chat, support tickets, or “verification” links.

## Non-goals for this domain

Not generic crypto news, price commentary, or ranked “best payment gateways” lists. Prefer linking to URLs above rather than inventing metrics or comparisons.
